preprocessing: SimpleImputer(median) and StandardScaler fitted inside each training fold
matching: 30 repeated Figshare samples matched to Italian VA1 within diagnosis (17 HC and 12 PD per dataset)
validation: Stratified 5-fold OOF, stratified on dataset-by-diagnosis cells; no participant appears in train and test in a fold
interpretation: feature-domain ablation sensitivity, not a causal feature-importance analysis
